title: Cadillac Surreal Dreamscape
description: A vibrant surreal painting depicts three Cadillac vehicles driving through a reflective, colorful liquid surface under a massive melting red sun with dripping lava. On the left, a large blue melting ghost-like creature with yellow eyes and a Cadillac sign stands beside a crumbling building labeled cadillac.com, while on the right a silhouetted woman floats above a black XT5 Series Cadillac against a starry purple cosmic sky.
prompt: Surreal psychedelic painting of three Cadillac cars driving through reflective colorful liquid under a giant melting red sun with dripping lava.
